provider: Alibaba Cloud OSS — new-user free trial

free_tier.stated: Current international page: 'Standard LRS resource plan: 500 GB for 1 month' (individual) / '1 TB for 1 month' (enterprise), stacking with a 5 GB/month perpetual allowance to 505 GB (individual) / 1,029 GB (enterprise) during the trial month. The help.aliyun.com (China) variant of the same doc instead states 20 GB for 3 months — the docs disagree, so treat 500 GB/1 month as the international figure and 20 GB/3 months as the China figure.

egress.terms: Outbound internet traffic free trial: 2 GB for 3 months (China doc), stacked with a 5 GB/month perpetual quota => ~7 GB/month. Paid after that. This is the hardest egress failure in the slot.

tooling: OSS S3-compatible API — rclone 's3' provider 'Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) Object Storage System (OSS)'; ossutil; OSS SDKs.
chaining: New-user-only, one trial per verified identity. The 500 GB is 30 days, not recurring. No free per-account multiplication.
limits_note: 1 month; 2 GB (trial) + 5 GB/month outbound traffic; 200,000 API requests for 3 months. A 500 GB store with 7 GB/month of egress is a write-only archive you cannot read back for free.
reliability_note: Reliable object store; the trial simply expires and billing starts on everything, with an SMS warning at exhaustion.
